item.title: Trump says U.S. has struck a deal for control of Venezuelan oil reserves
item.description: President Trump says a new deal with Venezuela would give the U.S. control of more than 65 billion barrels of oil reserves.

item.title: Global trade expert Wendy Cutler explores U.S. trade wars with Canada and Iran
item.description: The trade war escalated between the U.S. and Canada, and the Trump administration tried to cut off Iran economically. NPR's Scott Simon talks with Wendy Cutler of the Asia Society Policy Institute.

item.title: Fed's Kevin Warsh warns inflation is too high, sparking bets rate hikes are coming
item.description: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reiterated his commitment to fighting inflation in a major speech — raising expectations that rate hikes may be coming, though he did not clearly spell out a path going forward.
item.content:encoded:

item.description: Treasure Secretary Scott Bessent said oil pipelines will make Strait of Hormuz irrelevant in two years. Energy experts say that is unlikely to happen.

item.title: The Sisyphean path it took to get 'Coyote vs. Acme' to the big screen
item.description: Warner Brothers' decision three years ago to shelve a live action animated movie with Wile E. Coyote and the Roadrunner upset many fans. Here's what its release tells us about Hollywood economics.

item.title: She got an electric bill for $1,373. She's not alone
item.description: The price of electricity is soaring in the summer heat, when fans and air conditioners are working nonstop. In Tulsa, Okla., people are having their power cut when they can't pay their bills.
